newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - B. Stearns explains 360 Comm.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - B. Stearns explains 360 Comm.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst David Freedman said he upgraded 360 Communications Co to buy from attractive and said that it was his top pick among cellular stocks.
-- said company has rapidly growing earnings per share, and should have material free cash flow next year.
-- "Growth investors can start looking at cellular stocks now," especially 360, he said.
